jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer Microsoft Azure (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Kelvion

Unsere Mission ist es, mit Innovationskraft und Nachhaltigkeit die industrielle Transformation voranzutreiben. Ob bei der Optimierung von Rechenzentren, der Weiterentwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion oder der Neugestaltung von Kühl- und Klimatechniksystemen – unsere thermischen Schlüsseltechnologien stärken zahlreiche Branchen weltweit. Als „One Kelvion“ arbeiten wir kontinuierlich an Lösungen, die unsere Kunden noch erfolgreicher machen und gleichzeitig zu einer nachhaltigeren Zukunft beitragen.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

Stellenbeschreibung

Ihre Aufgaben

Aufbau, Betrieb und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Microsoft Azure Cloud-Plattform in einer hybriden IT-Landschaft
Konzeption und Implementierung cloudnativer Lösungen mit Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, Azure Functions und weiteren Managed Services
Entwicklung und Pflege von Infrastructure-as-Code-Lösungen mit Terraform und/oder Bicep
Erstellung und Optimierung von CI/CD-Pipelines sowie Automatisierung von Deployment-Prozessen
Integration von Azure mit On-Premises-Systemen, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Arc sowie weiteren Unternehmensplattformen
Umsetzung von Cloud-Sicherheitskonzepten durch RBAC, Managed Identities, Verschlüsselung, Audit Logging und Azure Policy
Planung und Begleitung von Cloud-Migrationsprojekten sowie der Modernisierung bestehender Anwendungen
Überwachung von Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Cloud-Kosten sowie Umsetzung von FinOps-Optimierungen

Ihr Profil

Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder vergleichbare IT-Ausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Cloud Engineering oder Cloud Platform Management
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure, insbesondere Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Networking, Virtual Machines, Storage, Azure Monitor und Log Analytics
Erfahrung mit Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Kubernetes Service und Azure Container Apps
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Terraform und/oder Bicep sowie Infrastructure as Code
Erfahrung mit Azure DevOps oder GitHub, Git, CI/CD-Pipelines und automatisierten Deployment-Prozessen
Kenntnisse in mindestens einer Skript- oder Programmiersprache wie PowerShell, Python, Bash, C#, Go oder Java
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

Unser Erfolg basiert auf Zusammenarbeit – wir fördern vielfältiges Denken, hören einander zu und schätzen jede einzelne Stimme. Kreativität entfaltet sich bei Kelvion dort, wo Menschen gehört, ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen und ihre Beiträge anerkannt werden.

Mit einem flexiblen Arbeitsansatz stellen wir das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden in den Mittelpunkt. Dies stärkt die Bereitschaft sich einzubringen und eröffnet damit neue Karrierechancen Wir ermutigen engagierte Persönlichkeiten ihre Entwicklung selbst in die Hand zu nehmen, neue Wege zu gehen und gemeinsam mit uns Zukunft zu gestalten.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

English Version

Cloud Platform Engineer Microsoft Azure (m/f/x)

Kelvion

Our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.

Together, We Shape the Future

Job Description

Your Responsibilities

Build, operate and continuously enhance the Microsoft Azure cloud platform within a hybrid IT environment
Design and implement cloud-native solutions using Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, Azure Functions and other managed services
Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using Terraform and/or Bicep
Create and optimize CI/CD pipelines and automate deployment processes
Integrate Azure with on-premises systems, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Arc and other enterprise platforms
Implement cloud security concepts through RBAC, managed identities, encryption, audit logging and Azure Policy
Plan and support cloud migration projects and the modernization of existing applications
Monitor performance, availability and cloud costs while implementing FinOps optimization measures

Your Profile

Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering or a comparable IT qualification with relevant professional experience
At least 3 years of professional experience in Cloud Engineering or Cloud Platform Management
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including Entra ID, Azure RBAC, networking, virtual machines, storage, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Kubernetes Service and Azure Container Apps
Strong knowledge of Terraform and/or Bicep as well as Infrastructure as Code
Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub, Git, CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes
Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, C#, Go or Java
Excellent English communication skills and a structured, self-driven and solution-oriented working style

At Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.

Together, We Shape the Future

You will work across complete application stacks, including browser applications, APIs, backend services, databases, authentication, integrations, infrastructure, and deployment, while reviewing and improving complex software solutions across multiple programming languages.

Build user-facing features and the APIs, services, and data models that support them

Diagnose authentication, authorization, persistence, networking, state-management, and deployment issues
Review and improve software written in multiple programming languages

Preserve functionality, behavior, architecture, and edge-case handling during code translation

jobs.description:

Senior Design/Developer
Type -
B2B contract / Temporary contract with Adecco Consulting.
Payrates -
up to 190 PLN net+VAT/h on B2B contract or 22 350 PLN gross/month on Temporary contract
Duration -
until 31st October 2027
Location
- Warsaw Hybrid

Experience:
14 + years overall software/product design experience, with 8+ years hands-on React/TypeScript development and a strong UI/UX design portfolio.
Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Design/Developer to act as the design and front-end technical lead for client facing Portals. This is a hybrid role combining UX ownership (requirements-to-prototype, design system governance) with hands-on senior front-end engineering leadership. The ideal candidate translates ambiguous business requirements into validated, high-fidelity prototypes, then leads (and codes alongside) the mid-level development team to deliver pixel-accurate, accessible, enterprise-grade portal experiences.
Key Responsibilities

Own the requirements-to-prototype pipeline: run discovery with business/product stakeholders, produce wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
Define and enforce UI/UX standards, interaction patterns, and design system usage across all TA Portal applications.
Architect and build key React/TypeScript front-end components and shared UI libraries, setting technical and design precedent for the team.
Review pull requests and provide constructive, actionable feedback to mid-level developers on both design fidelity and code quality.
Partner with backend/API teams to ensure front-end designs are technically feasible within service and data constraints.
Drive accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA) and responsive design across all portal screens.
Conduct usability testing/validation sessions and iterate designs based on user feedback and analytics.
Mentor mid-level UI/UX developers on both design thinking and React best practices.
Participate in architecture/design governance reviews as design owner for the portal.

Required Skills

Expert-level proficiency in design/prototyping tools (e.g., Figma), including component libraries and design systems.
Strong hands-on React.js + TypeScript development experience (component architecture, state management, hooks).
Demonstrated experience translating designs into production-quality, responsive, accessible UI.
Familiarity with containerized application environments (Docker/Kubernetes/OpenShift) and modern CI/CD pipelines.
Strong stakeholder management — comfortable defending design decisions to both business and engineering audiences.
Experience reviewing code and providing technical/design feedback within a team setting.

Nice-to-Have

Working knowledge of Java or .NET (for backend collaboration/awareness — not a core build requirement).
Experience with Micro Frontend architectures (Module Federation, single-spa).
Basic SQL/database knowledge.
Prior experience in financial services, fund administration, or transfer agency platforms.
